verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Stripe exposes an MCP server and agent SDKs so that *external* AI agents can call the Stripe API, and agent-first developer tooling (stripe-docs-13, stripe-docs-28, stripe-docs-29, stripe-gh-1/3/4), but there is no evidence of a built-in AI assistant embedded inside the Stripe product/dashboard that an end user can delegate tasks to directly.
